title: Massachusetts group restores 44 acres, mile of stream; butterflies follow
summary_full: In Harwich, Massachusetts, a former cranberry bog has undergone an incredible transformation into a vibrant wildlife haven. The Robert F. Smith Cold Brook Preserve now boasts revitalised wetlands and a natural stream, promoting the resurgence of various insects, including elusive butterflies. This restoration not only enhances community water quality and stormwater management but also creates an exciting living laboratory for ecological studies.
